brickwork.intro: Sinqobile Construction e fana ka ditshebeletso tsa kaho ya dibrick le masonry ho pholletsa le Johannesburg le Gauteng. Ho dingwaga tse 15 bahi ba rona ba dibrick ba ahile tsohle — ho tloha marobalo a serapa a ngata e le nngwe ho ya dintlo tsa karolo ya bobedi tsa dibrick tsa sefahleho. Ho aha ka dibrick Johannesburg ho baka R150–R450 ka square metre ka 2026, ho itšetlehile mofuta wa brick (stock, samente, kapa sefahleho) le bophara ba lerobalo. Re sebetsa le mefuta yohle ya dibrick: dibrick tsa stock tsa NFP, dibrick tsa samente, dibrick tsa sefahleho tsa letsopa (Corobrik, Brickfields), le dibloko tsa khoukhriti. Kaho e nepahetseng ya dibrick e hloka diphitlhelelo tse nepahetseng tsa mortar, dithala tse lekaneng, marobalo a emeng ka tshilafalo, le ho kenya DPC — ha ho ditšibolo. Lerobalo le lohilwe ke rona ke la matla, le hanang le bosa, mme le akhilweng ho phela nako e telele.

faqs.question: Kaho ya dibrick e baka bokae Johannesburg ka 2026?
faqs.answer: Ho aha ka dibrick Johannesburg ho baka R150–R450 ka square metre ka 2026. Marobalo a stock brick a baka R150–R220/m², dibrick tsa samente R250–R300/m², le dibrick tsa sefahleho tsa letsopa R300–R450/m². Ditheko tsa dibrick tsa raw di fapana ho tloha R1,600/1,000 (stock) ho ya R6,000/1,000 (dibrick tsa sefahleho tsa phahlo).

faqs.question: Phapang ke efe pakeng tsa dibrick tsa stock le dibrick tsa sefahleho?
faqs.answer: Dibrick tsa stock (NFP) ke dibrick tse nang le seriti se otlehileng tse reroang ho tlhakiswa — ke kgetho ya theko e tlase ka ho fetisisa bakeng sa marobalo ao a tla phethahatswa ka tlhakiso le peinti. Dibrick tsa sefahleho ke dibrick tsa letsopa tse bonolo le tse nepahetseng tse dirilweng ho ba sefahleho sa ho qetela se bonweng — di tla ka mebala le ditshwantsho tse fapaneng mme ha di hloke tlhakiso kapa peinti. Dibrick tsa sefahleho di baka ho feta mathomong (R3,500–R6,000 ka 1,000 ho fapana le R1,600–R2,500 bakeng sa stock) empa di boloka ditšenyehelo tsa tlhakiso le peinti nakong e telele.

faqs.question: Na marobalo a melelwane a hloka metheo?
faqs.answer: Ee. Lerobalo le lohilwe la melelwane le hloka motheo wa strip wa khoukhriti — ntle le ona, lerobalo le tla arohana, le kgahla, mme la ho qetela la oha ka lebaka la ho siswa ha mobu le morwalo wa molapo wa phefo. Bophahamo ba motheo bo itšetlehile bophahamo ba lerobalo le maemo a mobu, empa ka kakaretso 300–500 mm botebong le 300–400 mm bophara bakeng sa lerobalo la melelwane la 1.8 m. Re tsholla metheo ho ya ho ditlhophiso tsa boenjiniere.

faqs.question: Ho nka nako e kae ho aha lerobalo la melelwane?
faqs.answer: Lerobalo la tlwaelo la melelwane la lehae (30–50 metres ya mothanyana) le nka matsatsi a 5–10 a mosebetsi, ho kenyelletsa ho henya le ho tsholla motheo (matsatsi a 1–2), ho phola ha motheo (matsatsi a 2–3), ho aha ka dibrick (matsatsi a 3–5), le ho pheta (letsatsi le 1). Melelwane e telele kapa marobalo a dibrick tsa sefahleho a nka nako e telele ka nepo. Bosa bo kgona ho baka ditiisetso nakong ya selemo sa pula sa Gauteng.

faqs.question: Na o kgona ho tshwantsha kaho ya dibrick e leng teng bakeng sa dikamelo tse eketsehileng?
faqs.answer: Re etsa boiteko bohle ho tshwantsha kaho ya dibrick e leng teng ka ho fumana mofuta o tshwanang wa brick, boholo, le mmala. Bakeng sa dintlo tse khale moo brick ya mathomo e emisitsweng, re fumana tshwano e haufi ka ho fetisisa mme re kgona ho sebedisa dibrick tse rekuwang ho tswa ho barekisi ba ho tima. Mmala wa mortar o tshwantsanngwa ka ho fetola diphitlhelelo tsa mocheso le samente. Moahi wa dibrick ya tsebo e kgona ho fihlela tshwano e haufi ha ho theoha maemong a mangata.

faqs.question: Ho hlophisa serapa ho baka bokae Johannesburg ka 2026?
faqs.answer: Ho hlophisa serapa Johannesburg ho baka R150–R800 ka square metre ka 2026. Ho kenya serapa ho bonolo (dimela, jani, mulch) ho baka R150–R250/m². Ho hlophisa serapa ho felletseng ka ho peta, marobalo a thibela ho khetleha, le ho nosetsa ho baka R400–R800/m². Ho ntšetsa serapa sa ntlo ho felletseng bakeng sa sebaka sa 200 m² se baka R30,000–R160,000 ho itšetlehile bokgoni. Re fana ka dipuisano tsa mahala le dikotasene tse totobatseng.

faqs.question: Ke efe jani e ntle bakeng sa dimapo tsa Johannesburg?
faqs.answer: Kikuyu ke jani e tsebahalang ka ho fetisisa ya lehae Johannesburg — e hola kapele, e hanana le komelelo, e phehela kapele ho tswa kotsing, mme e sebetsa letsatsi le hotohoto. LM Berea (jani ya Berea) e ntle ho feta bakeng sa dibaka tse moriting tlas'a dikhuni. Jani ya buffalo ke kgetho e ntle e sa hlokeng tlhokomelo. Bakeng sa dibaka tse nang le bapaane (tse tloaelehileng maemong a mariha a Gauteng), Kikuyu e robala empa e phehela selemo sa pula. Re kgothaletsa Kikuyu bakeng sa dimapo tse ngata tsa Johannesburg haeba ha o na moriti o moholo.

faqs.question: Sisteme ya ho nosetsa e baka bokae?
faqs.answer: Sisteme ya motheo ya lehae ya ho nosetsa Johannesburg e baka R10,000–R30,000 e kenyilwe, ho itšetlehile boholo ba serapa le thata. Disisiteme tsa otomeiteke tse nang le disensoro tsa bosa le disona tse ngata di baka ho feta. Ho nosetsa ka drip bakeng sa dibaka le mellwane ke ho sebedisa metsi ho ntle ho feta disprinkler. Re hlophisa sisteme ho itšetlehile moralo wa serapa sa hao, ditlhoko tsa metsi tsa dimela, le matlalo a metsi a masepala.

faqs.question: Ke dimela dife tse hanang le bapaane ba Gauteng?
faqs.answer: Gauteng e nna le bapaane ba mariha (Mots'eanong–Phato), kahoo ho kgetha dimela ho bohlokwa. Dikgetho tse hanang le bapaane di kenyelletsa agapanthus, lavender, rosemary, Society garlic, wild olive, buffalo thorn, aloe, le jani ya seriti. Dimela tsa botropikale (dipalema, strelitzia, frangipani) di kgona ho phela le bapaane ba bonolo empa di hloka tshireletso nakong ya lehlakoreng le tsididi. Re kgetha dimela tse loketseng microclimate ya hao e kgetheha — dibaka tse lebile leboa di fuduma, ha dibaka tse lebile borwa le tse tlaase di na le bapaane ba mangata.

faqs.question: Na o fana ka tlhokomelo ya serapa ka mora ho kenya?
faqs.answer: Re shebahana le kgolo ya serapa le kaho ho feta tlhokomelo e tswelang pele. Leha ho le jwalo, re fana ka tlhahiso e totobatseng ya tlhokomelo tshwarang e koahelang dingolelo tsa ho nosetsa, nako ya ho khaola, lenaneo la ho nyolla, le mesebetsi ya mekhoa le mekhoa. Bakeng sa tlhokomelo e tswelang pele, re kgona ho kgothaletsa dipampiri tse tshephehilang tsa tlhokomelo ya serapa sephaleng sa hao.

faqs.question: Tlhokomelo ya thepa e bitsa bokae Johannesburg?

faqs.question: Tumelano ya tlhokomelo e akaretsa eng?
faqs.answer: Ditumelano tsa rona tsa bodulo di akaretsa ditekanyetso tsa kgwedi kapa kotara tsa thepa, ho hlwekisa maqela a metsi, ditekanyetso tsa masapo a metsi (ditamoko, ditoropo, geyser), ditekanyetso tsa tshireletso ya motlakase, tekanyetso ya mabala a pente, tekanyetso ya karabelo ya ntlo, le ditokiso tse nyane tse akaretsang ho tumelano. Ditokiso tse kholo di rekotwa ka theko e arohanang empa ka ditheko tsa tumelano tse thehilweng. O fumana le behetso ya dipitso tsa tshohanyetso.

faqs.question: Na le boloka dipropathi tsa khoebo?

Ditumelano tsa khoebo di akaretsa ditsebo tsohle tsa kaho, ditekanyetso tse behetsweng, taolo ya dikopo tsa babapatsi, le karabelo ya tshohanyetso. faqs.question: Na ke bolokwa le ho hlokomela thepa ya ka hang kang?

Bakeng sa ho kenya ba rona ba sebetsa le dihlahiswa tsohle tsa mehuta le mefuta, mme re kopana le barekisi ho netefatsa ditlhopho tse nepahetseng pele re fihla sebakeng.

faqs.question: Ho kenya monyako ho bitsa bokae Johannesburg?
faqs.answer: Ho kenya monyako wa kahare Johannesburg ho bitsa R1,500–R4,000 ka 2026, ho itshupetsa ka mofuta wa monyako le hore na moriano o hloka ho tokiswa kapa ho ntshafatswa. Ho kenya monyako wa kantle le wa tshireletso ho bitsa R3,000–R8,000. Ditheko tsena di akaretsa monyako, moriano (haeba ho hlokeha), mabota, le ho sebetsa ho kenya. Re fana ho barekisi bohle ba baholo ba menyako kapa re kenna menyako eo o e rekile.

faqs.question: Na le ka kenya karabelo ya ntlo kamoreng e leng teng?
faqs.answer: Ho ntse jwalo. Re kenya dikarabelo tsa rhinoboard/gypsum dikamoreng tse se nang karabelo ya ntlo jwale, kapa re nthafatsa dikarabelo tse koakoaneng. Tshebediso e kenyelletsa ho kenya moriano wa lehong kapa hlau, ho pata dibothe tsa karabelo ya ntlo, ho platisa mabaka, le ho kenya dicornice. E bitsa R150–R300/m² ho itshupetsa ka bophahamo ba karabelo ya ntlo le boholo ba kamore. Ho fanyiha ha letlakala la karabelo ya ntlo ho kopana le baleketsi ba rona ba motlakase.

faqs.question: Na le fana ka dihlahiswa kapa re kenya feela?
faqs.answer: Re ka fana le ho kenya (ho kgothallwa bakeng sa khofaro ya netefatso le ho nepahala ha tlhopho) kapa re kenne dihlahiswa tseo o di rekleng. Ha re fana, re netefatsa hore sehlahiswa se nepahala bakeng sa tshebediso — boholo bo nepahetseng, disebediswa, le theko. Haeba o rekile tsa hao, re tla netefatsa ditlhopho pele ho kenya ho thibela diphoso tse bitswang haholo.

faqs.question: Ho kenya boelokaneng ho nka nako e kae?
faqs.answer: Ho kenya dimpako tsa boelokaneng le countertop ho nka nako ya matsatsi a 2–4 ka tlwaelo, ho itshupetsa ka boholo le ho ba le thata ha boelokaneng. Sena se akaretsa ho kena dimpako, ho kenya countertop, dikopahano tsa masapo a metsi (sekhiri, dishwasher), dikopahano tsa motlakase (stove, oven, extractor), le diphetolelo tsa ho qetela. Templating ya countertop le ho haha (granite, quartz) e tlaleletsa nako ya matsatsi a 5–10 pele ya ho kenya.

faqs.question: Na le kenya menyako ya garaji?
faqs.answer: Ho ntse jwalo. Re kenya menyako ya garaji ya setshwantsho, e phindolosang, le e kgarumolang le disisteme tsa motoro tse otomatikilweng. Ho kenya ho akaretsa monyako, moriano, motoro, dikonterolo tsa ho fetola, le selekane sa tshireletso. E bitsa R8,000–R20,000 ho itshupetsa ka boholo ba monyako, disebediswa (hlau, aluminium, lehong), le sehlahiswa sa motoro. Re tokisa le ho babalela menyako ya garaji le dimotoro tse leng teng.

ceiling.intro: Sinqobile Construction e fana ka ditokiso tsa karabelo ya ntlo le ho kenya karabelo ya ntlo tse hlwaetsitsweng naheng yohle ya Johannesburg le Gauteng. Hoya ka o na le karabelo ya ntlo ya rhinoboard e welang e tswa ho ho tsholohela ha karabelo ya ntlo ya khutlo e le nngwe e koakoaneng ntlong ya kgale, kapa o hloka karabelo ya ntlo ya botjha ya bulkhead e kennetsweng boelokaneng ba sejoale-joale, masehlopha a rona a nang le maitemohelo a karabelo ya ntlo a phethela mosebetsi ka nepo le ho netefatsa boleng. Re akaretsa mefuta yohle ya karabelo ya ntlo — rhinoboard (Rhinolite), phatiso, PVC, lehong, le dikarabelo tsa ntlo tse emilweng tsa grid — mme re sebeletsa dikolobu tsohle tsa Johannesburg, Sandton, Midrand, Fourways, Randburg, Centurion, le Pretoria. Ditokiso tsohle tsa karabelo ya ntlo di tla le boitlamo ba mesebetsi bo ngotsweng.

subServices.name: Ditokiso tsa Karabelo ya Ntlo ya Rhinoboard
subServices.description: Rhinoboard (plasterboard) ke mofuta o tloaelehileng haholo wa karabelo ya ntlo Gauteng. Ho tsholohela ha metsi, bopotsi ba karabelo ya ntlo, le dilemo di e kentsang ho wela, ho bopa manchaka, kapa ho qhaqha. Re sehla le ho nthafatsa dikarolo tse koakoaneng, re boela re kgomaretse mabaka, re fesa ka Rhinolite, le ho penta ho lekana. Ditokiso tse ngata tsa rhinoboard di phethwa letsatsing le le leng.

subServices.name: Ditokiso tsa Karabelo ya Ntlo ya Phatiso
subServices.description: Dintlo tsa kgale hangata di na le dikarabelo tsa ntlo tsa phatiso ya tlwaelo tse hlahisang malaha a mofuta oa hairline, dikarolo tse se tsitsepetseng, kapa ho hloleha ha lekapo le leholo la slab. Re ntsha phatiso e sa tsitsepahang, re boela ho bapalisa sebaka, re kenya koete ya bonding, le ho phatisa botjha ho phethela hantle. Malaha a moralo a tiisetswa ka fiberglass mesh tape pele ya ho phatisa.

subServices.name: Ho Kenya Karabelo ya Ntlo ya Bulkhead
subServices.description: Dikarabelo tsa ntlo tsa bulkhead di theha tlhophollano ya moralo dikamoreng tsa ho dula le diboelo tsa boelokaneng. Re haha dibulkhead re sebedisa moriano wa hlau le rhinoboard, le kapa ntle le melapo ya leseli la LED. Dibulkhead di ka pata maqhubu a air-conditioning, molapo wa motlakase, le dipeipi tsa metsi mme di tlaleletse ho phethela ha boleng.

subServices.name: Ho Tokisa Karabelo ya Ntlo ya Ntlo ya Metsi
subServices.description: Dikarabelo tsa ntlo tsa ntlo ya metsi di amehilwe ke mosi, ho tsuba metsi, le dibaka tsa go tsholohela. Re ntsha dibothe tse nang le mabu kapa tse ikemiseditseng, re phekola sebaka le setlaholoho sa anti-fungal, re kenya rhinoboard e kananang le ho tsuba, le ho kenya pente e thibela mabu. Re kgothaletsa le ntlafatso ya phepelo ea moya ho thibela ho hlaselwa hape.

subServices.name: Ho Nthafatsa Karabelo ya Ntlo
subServices.description: Ha karabelo ya ntlo e fetang 30% e koakane, ho nthafatsa ho na le molaetsa o moholo ho ena le ho amama. Re ntsha karabelo ya ntlo ya kgale, re tekanya le ho tokisa bothata bafe kapa bafe ba moralo wa karabelo ya ntlo, re kenya brandering le rhinoboard e ntjha, re fesa phatiso, le ho penta — re siya phethela e kganthe, e sa boneng ditshwana naheng yohle.

subServices.name: Ho Kenya Cornice le Coving
subServices.description: Dicornice le dimoulding tsa cove di fana ka phetolelo e hlwekile pakeng tsa karabelo ya ntlo le leqhoa. Re fana le ho kenya dicornice tsa phatiso, polystyrene, le polyurethane, re bua ka nepo dikhutlong tsohle. Dicornice di kenngwa ka adhesive e maleba le setlatswi, di hlwekiswa hantle, le ho pentwa ho lekana le karabelo ya ntlo ya hao.

faqs.question: Ke hobaneng karabelo ya ntlo ya ka e wela kapa e bopa methetho?
faqs.answer: Mabaka a tloaelehileng haholo ke metsi e kena ho tloha ho ho tsholohela ha karabelo ya ntlo, maqela a metsi a koalehenyang, kapa ho tsholohela ha masapo a metsi hodimo ho karabelo ya ntlo. Metsi e tlatsa rhinoboard kapa phatiso, e baka hore e bofole le ho lahlehelwa ke bontswa ba yona ho brandering (moriano wa karabelo ya ntlo), mme boima ba metsi bo e tsuba fatshe. Mabaka a mang a akaretsa ho kgaohana ha brandering nakong ya ho kenya ha pele, le ho hloleha ha phatiso e kenyang dilemo dikaraelong tsa ntlo tsa kgale. Re ntseha re tseba le ho tokisa motheo wa metsi pele re tokisa karabelo ya ntlo — ho seng jwalo bopotsi bo boela ka dikgwedi.

faqs.question: Na ke lokisa kapa ke nthafatse karabelo ya ntlo ya ka?
faqs.answer: Tokiso e maleba ha bopotsi bo le hara — manchaka a metsi a le mong, karolo e qhaqhileng, kapa sebaka se le seng sa rhinoboard e welang. Re kgothaletsa ho nthafatsa botlalo ha karabelo ya ntlo e fetang 25–30% e amehilang, ha ho na mabu a akaretsang (a kenang botebong ba bothe), kapa ha brandering (moriano) e bola kapa e kgahlanang e sa nepahalang. Nakong ya tekanyetso ya hao ya mahala, re fana ka tekanyetso e ba nang le tumelo e hlalosang kgetho e fana ka boleng bo botle.

faqs.question: Ho tokisa karabelo ya ntlo ho nka nako e kae?
faqs.answer: Patch e nyane ya rhinoboard e nka dihoreng tse 2–4. Ho nthafatsa karabelo ya ntlo yohle ya kamore e le nngwe hangata ho nka matsatsi a 1–2 — letsatsi le le leng la ho kenya le ho bota, le letsatsi la bobedi la ho fesa skim le ho penta ha phatiso e oma. Ditokiso tsa karabelo ya ntlo ya ntlo ya metsi di nka dihoreng tse 3–6. Re fokotsa phekumetso le ho hlwekisa ka botlalo pele re tloha.

faqs.question: Ho tokisa karabelo ya ntlo ho bitsa bokae ka m² Johannesburg?
faqs.answer: Tokiso ya karabelo ya ntlo ya rhinoboard e bitsa R250–R400 ka m² Johannesburg ka 2026, ho itshupetsa ka ho ba le bopotsi le ho fitlhelleha ha kamore. Ho kenya karabelo ya ntlo e ntjha (fana le kenya, ho akaretsa brandering, rhinoboard, skim plaster, le pedi e le nngwe ya pente) ho bitsa R300–R500 ka m². Dikarabelo tsa ntlo tsa bulkhead di bitsa ho feta — R800–R1,500 ka mithara e iteletseng — ka ntlha ya moriano le ho phethela o tlaleletsegang ho hahiloeng. Re fana ka diqoto tse lokolohang, tse akaretsang hore o tsebe theko e nepahalang pele re qala.

faqs.question: Na bopotsi ba karabelo ya ntlo bo ka amohelwa ke inshorense ya ntlo ya ka?
faqs.answer: Ho ntse jwalo, dihlwekehi tse ngata. Haeba bopotsi ba karabelo ya ntlo bo bakoa ke ketsahalo e potlakileng le e sa behetsweng — jwalo ka peipi e phatlohelang, bopotsi ba hail karaelong ya ntlo, kapa ho kenella ha metsi ya mofefo — dipholisi tse ngata tsa inshorense ya ntlo ya Afrika Borwa di tla amohelana le tokiso. Bopotsi ba nako le nako ho tloha ho ho lahlehilwa ho tswelang ho hlokomela kapa ho hloleha ha tlhokomelo hangata ho lahlwa ka thoko. Re ka fana ka tekanyetso ya bohlwaela, e ngotsweng ya mabaka a bopotsi ho tsheheta dipolelo tsa inshorense ya hao.

faqs.question: Na karabelo ya ntlo e na le boleng e kae?
faqs.answer: Bakeng sa dikarabelo tsa ntlo tsa tlwaelo tsa bodulo tse nang le brandering e kgauswi ka mm tse 450, rhinoboard ya 9.5 mm ke tlhopho e tloaelehileng haholo mme e maleba bakeng sa dikamore tse ngata. Dikarabelo tsa ntlo tsa ntlo ya metsi le tsa boelokaneng di tlameha ho sebedisa rhinoboard ya 9.5 mm e kananang le ho tsuba (mohlobo wa MR). Bakeng sa brandering e kgauswi ka mm tse 600, bothe ba 12.5 mm bo kgothallwa ho thibela ho iphithisa hara span. Re lekola kamehla bokgauswi ba brandering le maemo pele re kgothaletsa tlhopho ya bothe.

subServices.description: Dipeipi tsa folisi metsi di rwala metsi ho tloha maqeleng a metsi ho isa fatsheng. Re fana le ho kenya dipeipi tsa folisi metsi tsa 68 mm le 80 mm tsa molapo, dibendi tsa offset, le dikhefisi ka aluminium, PVC, le hlau. Dipeipi tsa folisi metsi tse koalehenyang kapa tse qhaqhileng di ntshwa botho e hlwekisoa kapa e nthafatswa. Re netefatsa hore dipeipi tsa folisi metsi di ntshela ho drene ya metsi ya mpefe kapa epa, eseng ka ha motheo.

subServices.name: Ho Nthafatsa Dibothe tsa Fascia
subServices.description: Dibothe tsa fascia di tsheheta maqela a metsi le ho vala sekgeo pakeng tsa karabelo ya ntlo le soffit. Ho bola, ho koakana ha diruiwa tse ka hara ntlo, le dilemo tsa ho tsuba ha metsi di baka ho hloleha ha difascia. Re nthafatsa difascia tsa lehong ka difascia tsa fibre cement e peintiloeng kapa ya aluminium tse se hlokeng tlhokomelo mme di rwala netefatso ya nako e telele. Difascia tse ntjha di kenngwa pele ya ho boela ho nkenngwa ha maqela a metsi.

subServices.name: Ho Nthafatsa Dibothe tsa Barge
subServices.description: Dibothe tsa barge di sireletsa monyako wa karabelo ya ntlo dikhutlong tsa gable tsa ntlo. Re nthafatsa dibothe tsa barge tse koakoaneng tsa lehong ka ditumelo tsa fibre cement kapa aluminium, tse pitilweng le tse pentweng hantle ho lekana le mmala wa karabelo ya ntlo ya hao. Dibothe tsa barge tse nthafatsweng di thibela metsi ho kotobalela ka tlase ho ditaele tsa karabelo ya ntlo monyakonyana wa karabelo ya ntlo.

faqs.question: Maqela a metsi a sa theleheleng a bitsa bokae ka mithara Afrika Borwa?
faqs.answer: Ho kenya maqela a metsi ya aluminium a sa theleheleng Johannesburg ho bitsa R120–R180 ka mithara e iteletseng ka 2026, ho akaretsa dikhutliso, dielamente tsa mafeleng, le tsebiso ya dipeipi e le nngwe ya folisi metsi ka dimilimitara tse 6. Ntlo e tlwaelehileng ya malapeng a mabedi le 30–40 mithara e iteletseng ya maqela a metsi hangata e bitsa R4,000–R7,000 bakeng sa sistemo yohle ya aluminium a sa theleheleng. Maqela a metsi ya PVC ya dikarolo a bitsa R60–R100 ka mithara e iteletseng empa a hloka tlhokomelo e ngata le bophelo bo mokgutshwane. Re fana ka diqoto tse lokolohang, tse akaretsang hore o tsebe theko e nepahalang bakeng sa thepa ya hao.

faqs.question: Phapano pakeng tsa maqela a metsi a sa theleheleng le a dikarolo ke efe?
faqs.answer: Maqela a metsi ya dikarolo a tla ka bolelele ba tlwaelo ba 3 m kapa 4 m tse kopanyang hammoho ka dikhutliso le setlatswi. Mabaka ao ke mabaka a ka etsang ditsamaiso, mme mabaka a ka buea ha maqela a metsi a ongoloha le ho katloha ka maemo. Maqela a metsi a sa theleheleng a bopelwa sebakeng ka bolelele bo nepahetseng ba dibaka tsa hao — hangata 6–20 mithara ntle le mabaka tafoleng, feela dikhutlong. Maqela a metsi a sa theleheleng a phela nako e telele, a hloka tlhokomelo e nyane, le pontsho e ntle. Re kgothaletsa aluminium a sa theleheleng bakeng sa dipropathi tsohle tsa bodulo tse tsitsetseng.

faqs.question: Maqela a metsi a tlameha ho hlwekiswa hang kang?
faqs.answer: Johannesburg, re kgothaletsa ho hlwekisa maqela a metsi habedi ka selemo — ka la pele pele ya moetla wa pula wa selemo (Lwetse/Mphalane) ho netefatsa hore sistemo e ka sebetsa le difefo tsa mocheso o phahamileng, le habedi kamora ho wa ha matlakala a diphepo (Mmesa/Motsheanong) ho hlwekisa bothoto bo bokellwang. Dipropathi tse obehileng ka dihlare tse kholo di ka hloka ho hlwekiswa ka kotara. Maqela a metsi a koalehenyang a theola ka ho fetana le dibothe tsa fascia le metheo, e bakang ho tsuba ho bitswang haholo ho tokisa ho ena le ho hlwekiswa ka ho tloaeleha.

faqs.question: Ke hobaneng maqela a metsi a wela kapa a kgaolana le fascia?
faqs.answer: Mabaka a tloaelehileng haholo ke ho hloleha ha khutliso — dibireo tse tsenyang ditaki kapa dikhutliso tse kgauswane haholo. Bokgauswi ba tlwaelo ba khutliso bakeng sa maqela a metsi a lapeng ke 600 mm; bokgauswi bo seholo bo dumella maqela a metsi ho iphithisa ka boima ba metsi. Mabaka a mang a akaretsa bothe ba fascia bo bolang ka bo oeng (bo bolela hore disukiri ha di na seng se tiileng ho tshwara), bokellano ba bothoto bo tlaletsang boima, le maqela a metsi a kennetsweng ntle le ho wela ho lokelang hore metsi e bokellana le ho tlaleletsa moralo. Re tekanya dikhutliso le maemo a fascia e le karolo ya tokiso nngwe le nngwe.

faqs.question: Na bopotsi ba maqela a metsi bo ka baka ho tsuba ntlong ya ka?
faqs.answer: Ho ntse jwalo — maqela a metsi a theolang kapa a tsholohang ke mabaka a tloaelehileng a ho nyolla le ho kenella ha ho tsuba matlung a Afrika Borwa. Ha maqela a metsi a theola ka ha leqhoa, metsi e tlatsa phatiso le kereke le e ka kenella ho isa maqehelwaneng a kahare. Maqela a metsi a ntshela ka ha motheo a thusa ho nyolla ha ho tsuba. Ho tokisa maqela a metsi ke mohato wa pele ka phekolelo efe kapa efe ya ho tsuba — ho boela ho penta kapa ho phulo ya metsi maqehelwaneni a tsubang ntle le ho tokisa motheo wa metsi ke tjhelete e lahlehilang.

faqs.question: Na le kenya maqela a metsi Pretoria?
faqs.answer: Ho ntse jwalo. Re kenya maqela a metsi naheng yohle ya Gauteng ho akaretsa Pretoria, Centurion, Midrand, Sandton, Fourways, Randburg, Roodepoort, le dikolobu tsohle tsa Johannesburg. roof-waterproofing.intro: Sinqobile Construction e fana ka phulo ya metsi ya karabelo ya ntlo e hlwaetsitsweng naheng yohle ya Johannesburg le Pretoria. Re phulo ya metsi ya mefuta yohle ya karabelo ya ntlo — dikarabelo tsa ntlo tse nang le ditaele, dikarabelo tsa ntlo tsa hlau tsa IBR le tsa corrugated, difakatoro tsa beton tse a lekalekane, le Chromadek — re sebedisa sistemo e nepahalang bakeng sa substrate nngwe le nngwe. Masehlopha a rona a phulo ya metsi a nang le maitemohelo le dikhoforo tsa acrylic elastomeric, disisteme tsa torch-on bitumen membrane, le membrene tse fanoeng ka mokelikeli, mme re kgothaletsa sehlahiswa se nepahetseng bakeng sa karabelo ya ntlo ya hao ho itsehetse maemong a yona, dilemo, le moralo wa ho ntsha metsi. Mosebetsi wohle wa phulo ya metsi o qala ka ho lokisetsa maqephe le ho tekanya ka ho nepaheha — ho hloleha ha phulo ya metsi hangata ke sephetho sa ho lokisetsa ho sa lekalekane, eseng ho hloleha ha sehlahiswa. Re sebeletsa dikolobu tsohle tsa Johannesburg ho akaretsa Sandton, Midrand, Fourways, Randburg, le Roodepoort, le Pretoria, Centurion, le dibaka tse haufi. Mesebetsi yohle e tla le netefatso e ngotsweng.

subServices.name: Phulo ya Metsi ya Karabelo ya Ntlo ya Ditaele
subServices.description: Dikarabelo tsa ntlo tsa beton le tsa lenala di hlahisa malaha a manyane dikarabelong tsa ridge, diflashing tsa molapo, le dibethe tsa mortar nako le nako. Re hlwekisa maqephe a karabelo ya ntlo ka nepo, re boela ho tlatsa mortar ya ridge le ya hip e hlolehileng, re nthafatse ditaele tse qhaqhileng, le ho kenya membrene ya phulo ya metsi ya acrylic elastomeric maqepheng ohle a karabelo ya ntlo. Membrene e kopanya malaha a micro-crack, e etsaka le bo parolla UV ho fokotsa ho akeha ga hoya pele, le ho tlaleletsa bophelo ba phulo ya metsi ya lilemo tse 8–12. Dikarabelo tse ngata tsa ntlo tsa ditaele di tla le thuso ya pente ya karabelo ya ntlo ho boela ho mmala le ho sireletsa ditaele.

subServices.name: Phulo ya Metsi ya Karabelo ya Ntlo ya Hlau ya IBR le Corrugated
subServices.description: Maqephe a karabelo ya ntlo ya hlau ya IBR (inverted box rib) le corrugated a hlahisa taki, merumelo ya masukiri, le ho hloleha ha mabaka a kopahano. Re phekola taki ka mocheso wa ho fetoha ha taki, re nthafatse maqephe kapa disukiri tse koakoaneng, re pitala dikabo tsohle le difufu ka tepe ya butyl le setlatswi, le ho kenya khoforo ya karabelo ya ntlo ya hlau ya motlotlo — e le sehlahiswa se itsehetse ka bitumen kapa membrene ya rubber ya mokelikeli — maqepheng ohle. Sistemo ena e bohlokwa haholo Gauteng moo diphetoho tsa maemo a boleng di bakang hore dikarabelo tsa ntlo tsa hlau di ongolohe le ho katloha ka ho phaphama.

subServices.name: Phulo ya Metsi ya Karabelo ya Ntlo e Lekalekane le ya Beton
subServices.description: Dikarabelo tsa ntlo tsa beton tse lekalekane (dikarabelo tsa ntlo tsa parapet le difakatoro tsa garaji) ke tse thata haholo ho phulo ya metsi hobane metsi e bokellana e sa ntshi ho ntsha. Re tekanya moralo wa ho ntsha metsi pele, re ntlafatse diwe moo ho hlokeha, ebe re kenya membrene ya torch-on APP bitumen kapa sistemo ya phulo ya metsi ya cementitious crystalline ho itshupetsa ka maemo a slab. Dikabo tsohle, mabaka a ho atolosa, le ho tjhetla dipeipi di phekollwa ka thoko hobane ke mabaka a motheo a ho kenella ha metsi.

subServices.name: Ho Sekaseka le ho Tokisa Ho Tsholohela ha Karabelo ya Ntlo
subServices.description: Ho tseba motheo wa ho tsholohela ha karabelo ya ntlo ho thata ho ena le ho e tokisa — metsi e kena sebakeng se le seng mme e tsamaya pele e bonwe kahare. Re etsa ho tekanya ka tsamaiso maqepheng a karabelo ya ntlo, diflashing, maqela a metsi, diirone tsa molapo, le dikabo tsa karabelo ya ntlo (diveintana, dipeipi, dileseli tsa molapo) ho tseba sebaka sa ho kena sa nnete. Re tokisa ho hloleha ha ho itseng pele re kenya khoforo ya phulo ya metsi moo ho amehilang. Tokiso e laetseng e bitsa haholo e nyane ho ena le phulo ya metsi yohle ya karabelo ya ntlo le e maleba ha bopotsi bo haeletsana.

subServices.name: Disisteme tsa Torch-On Bitumen Membrane
subServices.description: Torch-on APP (atactic polypropylene) bitumen e fetotsweng ke sistemo e tlhophwang ya phulo ya metsi bakeng sa dikarabelo tsa ntlo tse lekalekane le maqoqa a parapet. Re kenya diqalo tse pedi — underlayer e tiisitsweng ka fibre glass le cap sheet e fetotsweng ka SBS — e torchiwang substrate bakeng sa membrene e kopaneng ka botlalo, e sa boneng ditshwana. Disisteme tsa torch-on di phela lilemo tse 15–20 ha di kenngwa hantle maqepheng a lokiselitsweng hantle. Mosebetsi wohle wa torch-on o etswa ke baetsi ba nang le maitemohelo ba latela maemo a SANS 10109.

subServices.name: Dikhoforo tsa Acrylic Elastomeric ya Karabelo ya Ntlo
subServices.description: Dikhoforo tsa phulo ya metsi ya acrylic di fanoeng ka borosi kapa molaola dikarabelong tsa ntlo tsa ditaele le tsa hlau e le khoforo ya tlhokomelo kapa sistemo e nyane ya phulo ya metsi. Di a ongoloha, di kananana le UV, mme di fumaneha ka dipalo tsa mebala ho boela ho mmala wa karabelo ya ntlo ka nako e tshwanang. Dikhoforo tsa acrylic di hloka ho boela ho kenngwa ka dilemo tse 5–8 ho itshupetsa ka ho senolwa ha UV le ho kena ha dinahana. Re tlhophe dihlahiswa tsa boholo bo hodimo (bonyane ha bo 300 microns bo oma ho nkwa) bakeng sa ho sebetsa ha phulo ya metsi ho lekanang.

faqs.question: Ho phulo ya metsi karabelo ya ntlo ho bitsa bokae Afrika Borwa?
faqs.answer: Ditokiso tsa phulo ya metsi ya karabelo ya ntlo Afrika Borwa di fapana ho tloha R80 ho isa R250 ka square metre ka 2026, ho itshupetsa ka mofuta wa karabelo ya ntlo le sistemo e sebediswang. Khoforo ya acrylic elastomeric karabelong ya ntlo ya ditaele e bitsa R80–R130/m²; torch-on bitumen membrane karabelong ya ntlo ya beton e lekalekane e bitsa R150–R250/m². Bakeng sa ntlo ya tlwaelo ya 120 m² ya ditaele, lebelela ho lefa R9,600–R15,600 bakeng sa khoforo yohle ya acrylic, le R18,000–R30,000 bakeng sa sistemo ya torch-on ya karabelo ya ntlo e lekalekane. Ditokiso tsa ditsamaiso tse haeletsanang di bitsa R800–R3,500 ho itshupetsa ka ho ba le bopotsi. Re fana ka diqoto tse lokolohang, tse akaretsang kamora ho tekanya karabelo ya ntlo ya hao.

faqs.question: Mofuta ofe wa phulo ya metsi o loketse karabelo ya ntlo?
faqs.answer: Sistemo e ntle ya phulo ya metsi e itshupetsa ka mofuta wa karabelo ya ntlo ya hao. Bakeng sa dikarabelo tsa ntlo tsa ditaele, khoforo ya acrylic elastomeric ke ya tlwaelo — e kopanya malaha a micro-crack, e etsaka le ho parolla UV, le ho boela ho mmala. Bakeng sa dikarabelo tsa ntlo tse lekalekane kapa tsa parapet tsa beton, torch-on APP bitumen membrane ke sistemo e phelang nako e telele haholo, e phelang lilemo tse 15–20 ha e kenngwa hantle. Bakeng sa dikarabelo tsa ntlo tsa hlau ya IBR kapa corrugated, membrene ya rubber ya mokelikeli ya motlotlo kapa khoforo e itsehetse ka bitumen e maleba. Ha ho sehlahiswa se le seng sa 'molemo' — kgetho e nepahalang e itshupetsa ka moralo wa karabelo ya ntlo, ho ntsha metsi, maemo a jwale, le tekanyetso. Re tlhophe sistemo e nepahalang kamora ho tekanya karabelo ya ntlo ya hao.

faqs.question: Phulo ya metsi ya karabelo ya ntlo e phela nako e kae?
faqs.answer: Bophelo ba dikgwetlho bo itshupetsa ka sistemo le boleng ba ho kenya. Dikhoforo tsa acrylic elastomeric ya karabelo ya ntlo di phela dilemo tse 5–8 pele di hloka ho boela ho kenngwa. Disisteme tsa boleng ba torch-on bitumen membrane (diqalo tse pedi tsa APP) di phela lilemo tse 15–20. Boleng ba ho lokisetsa maqephe bo na le sesupo se seholo phelong ho ena le sehlahiswa ka bo sona — le membrene e ntle ka ho fetisisa e tla hloleha kapele haeba e kenngwa maqepheng a ditshila, a qhaqhileng, kapa a sa primiswang hantle. Re latela maemo a SANS 10109 bakeng sa mesebetsi yohle ya phulo ya metsi.

faqs.question: Na ke tseba hore karabelo ya ntlo ya ka e hloka phulo ya metsi kapa feela ditokiso?
faqs.answer: Haeba ho tsholohela ho tswa sebakeng se le seng, se tsejwang — taele e qhaqhileng, irene ya molapo e hlolehileng, flashing e sa tsitsepahang — tokiso e laetseng hangata e lekanela le e bitswang haholo hanyane ho ena le phulo ya metsi yohle. Haeba karabelo ya ntlo e na le malaha a akaretsang a micro-crack, ditsamaiso tse ngata tse nyane dibakeng tse fapaneng, kapa khoforo ya phulo ya metsi e leng teng e sena mesokolo le ho lahlehela bontswa, ho phekola ka botlalo ho maleba ho feta. Re etsa tekanyetso ya mahala mme re fana ka kgothaletso e ba nang le tumelo hore o hloka ditokiso, khoforo, kapa sistemo yohle ya membrene.

faqs.question: Na o ka phulo ya metsi karabelo ya ntlo nakong ya mariha?
faqs.answer: Disisteme tse ngata tsa phulo ya metsi di hloka maemo a bonyane a 10°C le maemo a omileng bakeng sa ho kenya. Gauteng, mariha a batla a batla a bata empa a oma — matsatsi a mangata pakeng tsa Motsheanong le Phato a maleba bakeng sa mesebetsi ya phulo ya metsi. Ho se nang kwetsing le ho se nang pula ho etsahala mariha a maleba bakeng sa mosebetsi wa karabelo ya ntlo. Re lekola maemo a boemo ba leholimo letsatsi le letsatsi mme ha re kenne dihlahiswa kantle ho ditemine tsa bona tsa maemo a boleng le tsa kwetsing. Barekisi ba bangata ba fumana ho beha mesebetsi mariha ho rata hobane baetsi ba fumaneha ho feta mme dikarabelo tsa ntlo di oma.

faqs.question: Na le phulo ya metsi dikarabelong tsa ntlo Pretoria?
